candidates.excerpt: Keralam Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan and Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy attended the celebrations at the invitation of Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar. Several foreign dignitaries, including ambassadors, consuls general and high commissioners, also participated.

candidates.title: DRI busts Bangladesh-Kolkata-Hyderabad gold smuggling route, seizes Rs 5.84 crore haul
candidates.excerpt: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence arrested five people near Vijayawada after seizing gold and foreign currency worth Rs 5.84 crore. Officials allege the gold was smuggled from Bangladesh via Kolkata to Hyderabad. The agency also reported an earlier seizure near Visakhapatnam

candidates.title: Economists maintain back-to-back repo rate hike stance
candidates.excerpt: Economists expect the Reserve Bank of India to consider another 50-basis-point repo rate hike in December amid rising inflation risks and rupee weakness. October MPC minutes indicated a hawkish policy shift, while elevated bond yields and currency movements reflect market uncertainty

candidates.title: US, Israel prepare for fresh Iran strikes as Tehran threatens with ‘Father of All Bombs’
candidates.excerpt: The United States and Israel are preparing for potential military strikes against Iran after the upcoming midterm elections. Iran has announced it will reveal a new weapon called the 'Father of All Bombs' as tensions rise. US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to discuss military options recently. Meanwhile, Iranian officials warn of severe responses if attacked, emphasizing improved missile capabilities.

candidates.title: India slams UN rapporteur for falsely projecting Dawood Ibrahim as ‘India-based’
candidates.excerpt: India sharply criticised a UN Special Rapporteur's report for describing fugitive terrorist Dawood Ibrahim as being linked to an "India-based" D-Company without clarifying that he is a wanted terrorist who fled India decades ago. At the UN, India accused the rapporteur of factual inaccuracies and incompetence, warning that such omissions damage the credibility of the organisation.
